newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Hannaford Bros downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hannaford Bros downgraded.

text.p: Morgan Stanley said on Monday it lowered its rating on the shares of Hannaford Bros Co to neutral from outperform.
-- Analyst Debra Levin said in a research note she was lowering the rating following disappointing second quarter results and a difficult sales environment, which would prevent multiple expansion.
-- Hannaford reported second quarter earnings of $0.47 per share compared to $0.46 per share in the year-ago quarter.
--Levin said she was cutting her 1997 estimate to $2.00 per share from $2.06 per share and her 1998 estimate to $2.25 per share from $2.35 per share.
-- "Furthermore, and a concern for us, the competitive environment has worsened with a pick-up in competitive openings in HRD's core Northeast territory..." she said.
